router.description: Only a greeting such as hi, hoi, hallo, hello, merhaba or good evening, with nothing else asked or ordered

Is about menu items: wants to see, know about or order products. Asks what there is, for the menu or a category (sides, drinks, bowls), whether they have something, what an item is, contains or costs, items that fit a wish (with chicken, vegan, spicy, cheap), or the food in general (is the chicken halal, is it organic, gluten-free options); or wants to order or start ordering, even without naming anything yet (I want to order, ik wil bestellen, I'd like, I also want, give me, 2x, one more, add), says yes to items Marvin just offered, or answers Marvin's question about an item (which size, base, sauce or which one)
Wants items taken out of the basket or fewer of them: remove, delete, cancel the salad, only one instead of two
Asks what is in the basket now or what the total is, without changing it

The basket already has items and they are done choosing: want to finish and pay (that's all, checkout, pay, send the link, afrekenen), or say yes to Marvin's question whether to finish the order. Never when the basket is empty
Says whether they pick up or want delivery, or when they want the order, without ordering items in the same message
Asks about an order that is already placed and paid: where it is, when it arrives, its status
Wants the same as last time or their usual order
Asks Marvin to speak another language, or taps a language button
Asks one of the shop's own questions listed here
Wants something only staff can do: money back, a refund, a discount, a price correction, or complains about an order they already received
router.instructions: Apologise once and show understanding. Say you cannot arrange this in this chat, and that you cannot change prices or send money. Do not argue about the price and do not promise that someone will contact them.

router.description: Needs nothing done: says thanks, ok, great or bye, says they will think about it or are busy, or only reacts with an emoji
Cannot be understood, or it cannot be told what the shopper wants even with the conversation

faq.match: Opening hours, whether the shop is open now or tonight, until when they can order
Where the shops are, which shop is nearby, addresses
Questions about the shop itself: its story, team, way of working, or its food in general such as halal, organic or where ingredients come from. Not opening hours or locations
faq.instructions: Answer in 1 to 3 short sentences in your own words, only from the page text in the result. Don't paste it and don't send a link. If it doesn't answer the question, or the result is an error, say you don't have that information.

handoff.answer.en: Sorry, I can't arrange that in this chat.
handoff.answer.nl: Sorry, dat kan ik in deze chat niet regelen.
handoff.answer.es: Lo siento, no puedo encargarme de eso en este chat.
handoff.answer.de: Entschuldigung, das kann ich in diesem Chat nicht regeln.
handoff.answer.fr: Désolé, je ne peux pas m'en occuper dans ce chat.
